hook: Hard deadline: November 30, 2026. After removal, fast mode on Claude Opus 4.8 returns an error with no silent fallback — it will not revert to standard Opus 4.8. Teams relying on fast mode must migrate to Opus 5.5 before the cutoff to avoid broken workflows.
